findings.title: E1 did not migrate an already connected agent-browser session
findings.claim: D6 §3.3: page state and helper session survived moving views between windows
findings.detail: Host parks the view before E1_READY; runner first connects after READY. No active CDP/helper session exists at migration, and no move-back occurs. Only pre-park single-page performance is proven.
findings.suggestion: Retain successful parked-page result but remove existing-session survival claim until attach→interact→park→interact→reattach→interact is measured.

findings.title: E3 cross-origin fixture does not exercise cross-site OOPIF, and iframe fill readback check is nonspecific
evidence: 技研/实验/E3_快照覆盖与命令行为/main.cjs:25-32
技研/实验/E3_快照覆盖与命令行为/pages/frames.html:6-7
技研/实验/E3_快照覆盖与命令行为/run.mjs:62-75
findings.detail: Main page and iframe both use http://127.0.0.1 with different ports: cross-origin, same-site. Chromium site isolation ignores port. OOPIF Target.attachToTarget / session routing remains unproved. readBackViaSnapshot only checks E3值 exists anywhere, which is guaranteed by other inputs and cannot prove iframe value. The research document acknowledges no direct iframe value readback, so this is an overbroad conclusion rather than fabricated records.
findings.suggestion: Add different-site controlled fixtures, assert actual child targets/process separation, and use unique per-input values plus child-side readback.

findings.title: Command coverage generator accepts a nonexistent test ID
findings.detail: Generator only checks each command has a nonempty hardcoded COVERAGE entry and number of keys. It never reads 测试用例.md or checks test IDs/layers/criteria. Private copy changed snapshot mapping to nonexistent T999; generator exited 0 and output M12-T999. Source fixture reconstructed from frozen mapping table solely for generator behavior probe; not an independent Orca-source verification.
findings.suggestion: Check IDs against authoritative case parser and required I layer and explicit command mapping; add nonexistent ID negative control.

findings.title: 21KB Chinese type sample cannot establish 64KiB chunks finish within 90 seconds
evidence: 技研/实验/E3_快照覆盖与命令行为/run.mjs:125-132
技研/实验/E3_快照覆盖与命令行为/结果/result.json findings.type
findings.detail: Only 9000 characters / 21000 UTF8 bytes were measured: 14269ms. Document extrapolates 64KB≈40s by bytes, though typing is per character. At that observed per-character rate 65536 ASCII characters project to ~104s. This is not an actual 64KiB failure, but the stated 90-second guarantee is not supported.
findings.suggestion: Measure ASCII/CJK/emoji exact readback at 64KiB and >64KiB through intended executor under 90s budget before claiming guarantee.

findings.title: Experimental runners record results but do not assert expected outcomes or await cleanup completion
evidence: 技研/实验/E3_快照覆盖与命令行为/run.mjs:25-37,134-141
技研/实验/E2_网关耗时与大结果/gateway-measure.test.ts:42-53
findings.detail: E1/E3 catch and record errors and can exit 0 with failed steps; E2 size test never asserts expected exit/result/error. Current raw results do support the documented observations, but rerunning successfully at process/test level cannot establish behavior. host.kill() is not awaited nor PID descendants recorded by runners; separate manual cleanup claims are not independently reconstructible from artifacts.
findings.suggestion: Add semantic expected assertions and explicit expected negative outcomes, failed exit status, and scoped cleanup receipts.
